Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Locales.description: 1 to 64 locale tags (1 to 35 ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter, such as en, fr or pt-BR), unique ignoring ASCII case; the first is the fallback locale.

Entries.description: At most 65536 entries, in authored order (sorted by Key once cooked).

StringTableEntry.description: One key and its strings by locale.

Key.description: The entry's identity, which Loc.Get looks up: 1 to 256 bytes of text without control characters, unique in the table.

Values.description: The entry's strings by locale (each key one of the table's Locales, written sorted): at most 16384 bytes of UTF-8 each, line feeds and tabs their only control characters; the fallback locale's string is required, the others optional.
